section.content: 本发明公开了全基因组测序与宏基因组测序联合的微生物关联基因挖掘方法，具体涉及生物信息数据处理技术领域，包括获取目标群体的宿主全基因组测序数据、宏基因组测序数据和样本属性数据，并在工业云计算环境中执行双等位位点提取、基因型质控、目标微生物相对丰度计算以及固定项和主成分项解算，输出位点表、丰度表、固定项表和主成分项表；通过对固定项和主成分项逐项执行纳入与去除比较、解出同一宿主位点在不同协变量构成下的关联差异并据此确定显现项后结合基因注释筛出条件显现位点和候选基因。

The invention discloses a microorganism associated gene mining method combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencing, which particularly relates to the technical field of biological information data processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data of a target group, performing double-allele extraction, genotype quality control, target microorganism relative abundance calculation and fixed item and principal component item calculation in an industrial cloud computing environment, outputting a locus table, an abundance table, a fixed item table and a principal component item table, and performing inclusion and removal comparison on the fixed item and the principal component item one by one to solve the associated difference of the same host locus under different covariant compositions, and determining a condition display locus and a candidate gene by combining gene annotation after the display item is determined according to the associated difference.

Microorganism-associated gene mining method combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencingTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of biological information data processing, in particular to a microorganism-associated gene mining method combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencing.

Background

In the combined analysis of host whole genome sequencing data and intestinal metagenome sequencing data, the prior art mainly surrounds the development of the correlation discovery between host genetic variation and microorganism abundance traits, in the practical treatment, the whole genome sequencing data is generally subjected to double allele site extraction, genotype quality control and population layering treatment, then a microorganism relative abundance phenotype is formed according to the metagenome sequencing result, and factors such as variety, pig farm, sex and the like and main component results are incorporated into a correlation analysis model together so as to obtain significant sites and corresponding candidate genes thereof;

Taking continuous research of live pig breeding groups as an example, the whole genome data and the metagenome data of individuals in different batches need to be continuously imported into an industrial cloud computing environment, and synchronously carrying out association analysis on various microbial traits, and meanwhile, each batch of tasks is required to use a consistent data processing rule, a fixed effect processing mode and a main component introduction mode, so that front and rear results can be directly read and reused;

However, in this application case, a phenomenon often occurs that the same host site can form a significant association under one covariate composition, but no longer significant under another covariate composition, and the phenomenon does not fluctuate as individual results, but repeatedly occurs in the batch analysis process, resulting in that a part of host regulatory sites actually functioning only under a specific variety background, pig farm background or group layered background are weakened or even omitted together after unified correction, resulting in a final output result being more biased to the covariate processing mode, without completely reflecting the appearance characteristics of the site itself, because the existing analysis path mainly uses the fixing effect and the principal component as correction factors, but does not further distinguish the limiting effect of these factors on the appearance range of the host site;

the application aims to solve the technical problem of identifying and retaining host regulatory sites only appearing under specific covariate composition in the process of excavating microorganism-associated genes by combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencing.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to overcome the above-mentioned drawbacks of the prior art, embodiments of the present invention provide a microorganism-associated gene mining method combining whole genome sequencing with metagenome sequencing, which solves the problems set forth in the above-mentioned background art by performing inclusion and removal comparisons on fixed items and principal component items item by item, solving the associated differences of the same host site under different covariate constitutions, and accordingly determining the emerging items, and screening out conditional emerging sites and candidate genes in combination with gene annotation.

In order to achieve the aim, the invention provides the following technical scheme that the method for excavating the microorganism-associated genes by combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencing comprises the following steps:

s1, acquiring host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data of a target population, performing bi-allele site extraction, genotype quality control, target microorganism relative abundance calculation and fixed term and principal component term calculation in an industrial cloud computing environment, and outputting a site table, an abundance table, a fixed term table and a principal component term table;

S2, aiming at each target microorganism in the abundance table, keeping the site table and the abundance table unchanged, and constructing a comparison group table with only one comparison item changed according to the single item inclusion and item removal in the fixed item table and the main component item table;

S3, distributing the comparison group tables to parallel computing nodes in the industrial cloud computing environment, calling the same position table and the same abundance table for each comparison group, executing two times of association computation, and outputting the position comparison table;

S4, collecting the same host position in the position point comparison table according to comparison items, calculating a difference value, recording a direction turning item, determining a display item according to the total accumulated difference value and the number of the direction turning items, and outputting a display position table;

s5, screening out condition development sites according to the development site table, executing candidate gene annotation, writing in the condition development sites, corresponding target microorganisms, corresponding development items and corresponding candidate genes, and outputting excavation results.

In a preferred embodiment, in S1:

S1-1, acquiring host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data, performing one-to-one alignment and deletion elimination according to unified sample identification in an industrial cloud computing environment, and generating a joint sample table with consistent sample sequence;

S1-2, based on a combined sample table, performing double allele extraction, deletion site elimination and deletion sample elimination on the host whole genome sequencing data to generate a site table, and performing normalization on metagenome sequencing data according to the total reads number of samples to generate an abundance table;

S1-3, based on the joint sample table, performing deduplication merging on category fields in sample attribute data according to field types to generate a fixed item table, constructing a sample site matrix according to the site table, performing covariance matrix calculation and eigenvalue descending extraction, and generating a main component item table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S2 comprises:

S2-1, constructing a term matrix and a fully-incorporated state vector according to a fixed field sequence for each item in a fixed term table and a main component term table, respectively executing single-item overturn for each item in the fully-incorporated state vector to generate a candidate state vector set which is only one-bit different from the fully-incorporated state vector, extracting a reserved term matrix from the term matrix according to each candidate state vector, and outputting a candidate state table;

S2-2, aiming at each reserved item matrix in the candidate state table, taking an abundance vector corresponding to a target microorganism in the abundance table as input, sequentially performing gram matrix construction, eigenvalue decomposition, condition number calculation, singular value decomposition, orthogonal basis extraction, regularized linear solution and projection reconstruction, solving projection vectors, residual vectors, projection energy, residual energy, information divergence and condition numbers corresponding to the candidate states, and writing the projection vectors, the residual vectors, the projection energy, the residual energy, the information divergence and the condition numbers into the state evaluation table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S2, further comprising:

S2-3, aiming at the state evaluation table, respectively collecting corresponding candidate states according to the turnover single items, sequentially ordering according to the dictionary sequence from large to small in projection energy, small to large in residual energy, small to large in information divergence and front to back in field sequence in the same turnover single item, determining the unique reserved state corresponding to each turnover single item, and writing the inclusion item set, the removal item set, the turnover single item, the projection vector and the residual vector corresponding to the unique reserved state into the comparison group table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S3 it comprises:

s3-1, respectively solving corresponding calculated quantity, memory occupied quantity and public data complex quantity based on the sample quantity, the bit quantity and the inclusion item quantity of each comparison group in the comparison group table, constructing an allocation cost matrix between the comparison group and parallel calculation nodes, executing two-part matching and maximum load minimization sequencing on the allocation cost matrix, and determining unique allocation results from large to small according to the public data complex quantity and node numbers from small to large when the total cost is the same, so as to generate a node allocation table and a public cache table;

S3-2, each parallel computing node calls the states of the inclusion item and the removal item in the same position table, the same abundance table and the corresponding comparison group according to the node allocation table, respectively constructs two groups of associated design matrixes, sequentially executes the construction of the gram matrix, orthogonal decomposition, regularized linear solution and log likelihood solution on the two groups of associated design matrixes, multiplexes the number vector of the previous wheel train, the residual vector and the likelihood value in each iteration, executes Newton updating, stops the iteration when the symbol sequence of the number of the continuous two wheel trains and the lifting direction of the likelihood value are kept consistent, and outputs the effect value, the direction value, the residual value and the likelihood value of each host site in two states.

In a preferred embodiment, in S3, further comprising:

S3-3, each parallel computing node constructs a locus result fingerprint based on the effect value, the direction value, the residual value and the likelihood value in two states, invokes locus result fingerprints of a homologous comparison group according to a public cache table to execute consistency check, directly reserves a current result when the locus result fingerprints are consistent, executes sample sequence rearrangement, matrix reconstruction and re-association calculation on a corresponding comparison group when the locus result fingerprints are inconsistent, and determines a unique reserved result between a recalculation result and an original result according to the residual value from large to large, the likelihood value from large to small and the matrix condition number from small to large, so as to generate a check result table;

S3-4, based on the checking result table, respectively recording the effect value difference, the direction turning mark, the residual error difference and the likelihood difference in the condition of the inclusion item and the condition of the removal item for the same host site, and writing the effect value difference, the direction turning mark, the residual error difference, the likelihood difference and the corresponding comparison group identification into the site comparison table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S4 it comprises:

S4-1, aiming at each host site in the site comparison table, collecting corresponding inclusion state effect values, removal state effect values, inclusion state direction values and removal state direction values according to comparison items, calculating effect difference absolute values, residual difference absolute values and likelihood difference absolute values corresponding to the comparison items, and generating a site collection table;

s4-2, based on the site collection table, for each comparison item of each host site, under the condition that the inclusion state direction value is the same as the removal state direction value, the effect difference absolute value, the residual difference absolute value and the likelihood difference absolute value form a homodromous difference group according to the field sequence, and under the condition that the inclusion state direction value is opposite to the removal state direction value, the corresponding comparison item is marked as a direction turnover item, and the site difference table is generated.

In a preferred embodiment, in S4, further comprising:

s4-3, aiming at each host site in the site difference table, respectively performing intra-group rank ordering on each homodromous difference group, accumulating according to the rank order to generate total accumulated difference, performing counting on turning items in each direction to generate the number of the turning items, and determining the appearance items of each host site from the large to the small of the total accumulated difference, the number of the turning items from the large to the small and the field sequence of comparison items from the front to the back to generate an appearance judging table;

s4-4, extracting the display items, the total accumulated difference values and the number of turnover items corresponding to each host site according to the display judging table, and writing the host site, the display items, the total accumulated difference values and the number of turnover items into the display site table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S5 it comprises:

S5-1, acquiring a presentation site table and a reference gene annotation table, sequencing all host sites in the presentation site table according to target microorganisms, chromosome numbers and genome coordinates, and comparing all host sites with gene intervals in the reference gene annotation table one by one to generate a site annotation relation table comprising a falling zone gene identifier, an upstream adjacent gene identifier, a downstream adjacent gene identifier, an upstream boundary distance and a downstream boundary distance;

S5-2, based on a site annotation relation table, collecting host sites according to a combination relation of target microorganisms, falling zone gene identifications or upstream adjacent gene identifications and downstream adjacent gene identifications, respectively accumulating the total accumulated difference value, the number of accumulated turnover items and the number of statistical host sites for each display item in each collection result, determining unique display items from large to small according to the total accumulated difference value, the number of turnover items from small to large, the number of host sites from large to small and the sequence of display item fields from front to back, reserving corresponding host sites as conditional display sites, and generating a conditional display site table.

In a preferred embodiment, in S5, further comprising:

S5-3, aiming at each collecting result in the condition display site table, taking the falling zone gene mark as a candidate gene when the falling zone gene mark exists, and determining the candidate gene from small to large according to the boundary distance between the upstream adjacent gene mark and the downstream adjacent gene mark when the falling zone gene mark does not exist, and the total accumulated difference value of the corresponding host sites from large to small and the sequence of the gene marks from front to back to generate a candidate gene table;

S5-4, performing association writing on the condition development sites, the corresponding target microorganisms and the corresponding development items in the condition development site table and the candidate genes in the candidate gene table to generate an excavation result table containing the condition development sites, the corresponding target microorganisms, the corresponding development items and the corresponding candidate genes.

The invention has the technical effects and advantages that:

1. According to the scheme, through the inclusion and removal of the fixed items and the principal component items item by item and the construction of a comparison group, the appearance difference of the host site under different covariate compositions can be solved independently, so that the identification and retention of the host regulatory site only appearing under specific covariate compositions are facilitated;

2. The site table, the abundance table, the fixed item table and the main component item table with the same sample sequence are firstly generated, and then the same site table and the same abundance table are kept unchanged in the subsequent steps, so that the interference of input drift on comparison results can be reduced, and the correlation results under different comparison items are more convenient to read directly;

3. The projection energy, residual energy, information divergence and condition number are calculated for the reserved item matrix corresponding to each candidate state, and the unique reserved state is determined according to the calculated projection energy, residual energy, information divergence and condition number, and the interpretation capability and numerical stability in the construction process of the comparison set can be simultaneously restrained, so that the performability and consistency of the comparison set are relatively improved;

4. The comparison groups are distributed to the parallel computing nodes and shared data multiplexing is executed by combining the public cache table, so that the resource consumption caused by repeated retrieval of the site table and the abundance table can be relatively reduced during the concurrent computation of multiple comparison groups, and the method is more suitable for industrial cloud computing processing scenes of continuous batch tasks;

5. constructing a site result fingerprint for the association result in the inclusion item state and the removal item state, and executing homologous comparison group consistency check, so that sample sequence drift, matrix reconstruction difference and node calculation fluctuation can be screened out again, and the stability of the site comparison result is relatively improved;

6. Screening out condition display sites according to display items, and executing candidate gene determination by combining gene intervals, adjacent genes and boundary distances, so that display conditions of host sites and gene annotation relations can be synchronously reserved, and subsequent development of explanation and rechecking of microorganism related genes is facilitated.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a block diagram of the method steps of the present invention.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present invention will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the invention without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the invention.

Referring to fig. 1 of the drawings, the method for mining microorganism-associated genes by combining whole genome sequencing and metagenome sequencing of the present invention comprises:

s1, acquiring host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data of a target population, performing bi-allele site extraction, genotype quality control, target microorganism relative abundance calculation and fixed term and principal component term calculation in an industrial cloud computing environment, and outputting a site table, an abundance table, a fixed term table and a principal component term table;

In the embodiment, S1 is used for unifying host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data under the same target group boundary before entering a subsequent comparison group construction, generating a site table, an abundance table, a fixed item table and a main component table which are directly called subsequently, wherein the processing sequence is that firstly sample alignment and deletion elimination are completed, then host site screening and microorganism abundance resolving are completed, and finally fixed item merging and main component extraction are completed, and the implementation process comprises the following steps:

In S1-1, the input quantity comprises sample identification fields in host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data; the processing action is that firstly, a normalization mapping is executed on sample identifications in three types of data according to a unified coding table in an industrial cloud computing environment, then, intersection is calculated according to the normalized sample identifications, and samples simultaneously existing in the three types of data are reserved; checking the corresponding record number of intersection samples one by one, when repeated records exist in any data, uniquely reserving according to the sequence of consistent priority of sampling batches, high priority of field integrity and near priority of recording time, then checking the integrity of key fields, wherein the key fields comprise unified sample identifiers, host identifiers, sampling batches, sampling sausage sections and fixed item source fields, eliminating the corresponding samples when any key field is missing, finally arranging the corresponding samples in ascending order according to the unified sample identifiers to generate a combined sample table, wherein the output quantity is the combined sample table, the combined sample table at least comprises the unified sample identifiers, the host identifiers, the sampling batches, the sampling sausage sections and record indexes corresponding to three types of data, and writing the record indexes into a middle table storage area for S1-2 and S1-3 to read;

In S1-2, the input quantity comprises a combined sample table, host whole genome sequencing data and metagenome sequencing data, wherein the processing action comprises extracting host whole genome sequencing records according to the sample sequence in the combined sample table, counting the number of allelic states of all samples bit by bit, only keeping the number of loci equal to two, calculating the locus deletion rate of the kept loci bit by bit, wherein the locus deletion rate is the number of the locus deletion samples divided by the total number of the current samples, removing the loci when the locus deletion rate is greater than the locus deletion rate threshold in the flow configuration table, and then calculating the sample deletion rate of the residual loci bit by sample, wherein the sample deletion rate is the number of the sample deletion points divided by the total number of the residual loci, removing the samples when the sample deletion rate is greater than the sample deletion rate threshold in the flow configuration table, and synchronously updating the combined sample table;

Extracting corresponding count records from metagenome sequencing data according to the sequence of the updated combined sample table, counting target microorganism counts under a unified classification level, dividing the target microorganism counts by the total reads of the samples to generate an abundance table, wherein the abundance table at least comprises a unified sample identifier, a target microorganism identifier, a classification level identifier and a relative abundance value, the output is a locus table and an abundance table, which are respectively written into a locus storage area and a phenotype storage area for S2 to read;

The input quantity comprises an updated joint sample table, sample attribute data and a locus table, wherein the processing action is that firstly, sample attribute data is read according to the sample sequence in the joint sample table, deduplication and merging are carried out on category fields, the category fields at least comprise varieties, pig farms and sexes, category coding values are given to each category value according to the code table sequence, sample corresponding coding columns consistent with the sample sequence of the joint sample table are generated, a fixed item table is formed, and the fixed item table at least comprises a fixed item name, a field source, a category value, a category coding value, a field sequence number and sample corresponding codes;

The method comprises the steps of establishing a sample site matrix according to a site table, centering the sample site matrix according to the column, resolving the covariance matrix, performing eigenvalue decomposition on the covariance matrix, arranging eigenvalues in descending order, extracting corresponding eigenvectors to generate a principal component item table, wherein the principal component item table at least comprises a principal component number, corresponding eigenvalues, a field sequence number and a score value of each sample on the principal component, wherein output quantity is a fixed item table and a principal component item table, and the fixed item table and the principal component item table are respectively written into a fixed item storage area and a principal component storage area for S2 reading;

through the processing, S1 uniformly converts the original sequencing data and sample attribute data into four bottom tables with consistent sample sequence, fixed field sequence and definite source relation, the four bottom tables are directly called by subsequent comparison group construction and association calculation, sample alignment, site screening and attribute merging are not repeatedly executed, in practical application, a combined sample table is firstly generated for host whole genome sequencing data, intestinal metagenome sequencing data and variety pig farm sex attribute data of the same batch of live pig samples, a site table and an abundance table are regenerated, and finally a fixed item table and a main component item table are generated, so that the subsequent comparison group construction step can be directly entered.

S2, aiming at each target microorganism in the abundance table, keeping the site table and the abundance table unchanged, and constructing a comparison group table with only one comparison item changed according to the single item inclusion and item removal in the fixed item table and the main component item table;

In the embodiment, S2 is used for converting a fixed item list and a main component item list into a comparison group list which can be directly called by subsequent association calculation on the premise that a site list and an abundance list are kept unchanged, wherein the processing sequence is that candidate states are generated according to a unified field sequence, projection evaluation is carried out on a reserved item matrix corresponding to each candidate state, and finally a unique reserved state is determined in the same turnover item, so that each turnover item is guaranteed to only correspond to one group of inclusion item set and removal item set, repeated grouping of the same comparison item by the subsequent association calculation is avoided, and the implementation process comprises the following steps:

S2-1, wherein the fixed item table and the main component item table are uniformly organized into a reversible and indexable state structure, and a candidate state table for changing only one comparison item is formed; the input quantity comprises a fixed item list, a main component item list and a field sequence list, wherein the fixed item list at least comprises a fixed item name, a field source, a category code column and a field sequence number, the main component item list at least comprises a main component number, a main component column and a field sequence number, the processing action is that firstly, the fixed item and the main component item are sequentially written into an item matrix according to the field sequence list, the item matrix takes a sample as a row and the item as a column, the fixed item is written into the fixed item as a whole as a turnover unit, the main component item is written into the fixed item as a single main component, then a fully-incorporated state vector is constructed, each bit of the fully-incorporated state vector corresponds to one turnover unit one by one, a value 1 represents incorporation, a value 0 represents removal, and then, the single turnover is sequentially executed for each turnover unit in the fully-incorporated state vector, and only the state bit corresponding to the current turnover unit is rewritten from 1 to 0 each time, and the rest state bits are kept to 1, so that a candidate state vector set is generated;

Then extracting a column with a state bit of 1 from the item matrix according to each candidate state vector to form a corresponding reserved item matrix, and recording a turnover single name, a turnover single category, a turnover single field sequence number, an inclusion item set and a removal item set; the output quantity is a candidate state table, and the candidate state table at least comprises a candidate state number, a turnover single item identifier, a candidate state vector, a reserved item matrix index, an inclusion item set and a removal item set, and is written into an intermediate state storage area for S2-2 reading; the exception or deletion processing is that when the fixed item list or the main component list is empty, the empty candidate state list is directly returned, when the fixed item has a plurality of code columns, the code columns are synchronously overturned as the same overturned unit and are not allowed to be split and overturned, when the sequence number of the field is repeated, the fixed item is prioritized over the main component item, the inside of the fixed item is rearranged according to the word classical sequence of the field name, and the inside of the main component item is rearranged according to the ascending sequence of the main component number and returned to the writing section sequence list;

S2-2, calculating the interpretation capability and numerical stability of each retention item matrix in the candidate state table on the target microorganism abundance vector, and forming a state evaluation table required by the subsequent unique retention state judgment; the input quantity comprises a candidate state table, an abundance table and a target microorganism identifier, wherein the abundance table at least comprises a unified sample identifier, a target microorganism identifier and a relative abundance value; the method comprises the steps of firstly extracting abundance vectors consistent with a sample sequence of a joint sample table from the abundance table according to target microorganism identifications, and executing the following operation on each reserved item matrix in a candidate state table, firstly multiplying reserved item matrix transpose matrices by reserved item matrices to construct a gram matrix, then executing eigenvalue decomposition on the gram matrix, taking the ratio of a maximum eigenvalue to a minimum nonzero eigenvalue as a condition number for representing the numerical stability of the reserved item matrix, executing singular value decomposition on the reserved item matrices to extract left singular vectors to form orthogonal basis, then taking the abundance vectors as observation vectors, executing regularized linear solution with the minimum reconstruction error on the space of the orthogonal basis Zhang Chengzi as a target, adopting a ridge type to solve caliber in the regularized linear solution, taking the regularized parameter from a regularized parameter field in a flow configuration table, reconstructing a projection vector according to the solved coefficient vector and the orthogonal basis, and subtracting the projection vector from the abundance vector to obtain a residual vector;

The method comprises the steps of calculating projection energy and residual energy, wherein the projection energy is the sum of squares of elements of projection vectors, the residual energy is the sum of squares of elements of residual vectors, the projection vector and the abundance vectors are normalized into probability forms according to the sum of elements, KL divergence of a normalization result of the projection vector relative to a normalization result of the abundance vectors is used as information divergence, output quantity is a state evaluation table, the state evaluation table at least comprises candidate state numbers, turnover single identifications, projection vectors, residual vectors, projection energy, residual energy, information divergence and condition numbers, and the state evaluation table is written into an evaluation result storage area for S2-3 to read, abnormal or missing processing is that when the sum of elements of the abundance vectors is zero, the state evaluation table is not built for a current target microorganism, an empty result is returned, when a minimum non-zero characteristic value of a gram matrix does not exist, the condition numbers are recorded as maximum condition number segment values in a flow configuration table, and when zero elements are calculated, zero values in the normalization result are calculated according to the minimum positive numbers in the flow configuration table;

S2-3, the aim is to determine a unique reserved state for each turnover item from a state evaluation table and generate a comparison group table directly called by subsequent association calculation; the input quantity comprises a state evaluation table and a candidate state table; the method comprises the steps of processing actions, namely firstly, grouping and collecting candidate states in a state evaluation table according to a turnover single item identifier to enable all candidate states corresponding to the same turnover single item to enter the same group, and then, in each turnover single item group, sequentially sorting dictionary sequences according to the projection energy from big to small, residual energy from small to big, information divergence from small to large, condition number from small to large and field sequence number from front to back, wherein when a size relation occurs to a previous sorting bit, directly determining a sequencing sequence, and only entering a next sorting bit for comparison when the numerical value of the previous sorting bit is the same;

The first candidate state of the sequence is determined to be the unique reserved state of the turnover single item, then an inclusion item set is extracted from the unique reserved state, an item set is removed, the turnover single item, a projection vector and a residual vector are written into a comparison group table according to the sequence of the fields of the turnover single item, the output quantity is the comparison group table, the comparison group table at least comprises a comparison group number, a turnover single item identification, the inclusion item set, the removal item set, the projection vector and the residual vector, and the parallel node allocation and the association design matrix construction in the S3 are directly read;

Through the processing, S2 converts the fixed item list and the main component item list into the comparison group list, so that each turnover item corresponds to a unique, reusable inclusion item set and a removal item set which can be directly called, and subsequent association calculation does not need to reconstruct groups of the fixed item and the main component item again, thereby ensuring that the comparison items under the same position list and the same abundance list have unique change sources and consistent comparison caliber;

In practical application, an item matrix and a total inclusion state vector are constructed according to items of varieties, pig farms, sexes and principal components of the same target microorganism, candidate states are obtained by overturning item by item, projection energy, residual energy, information divergence and condition number are calculated for a reserved item matrix corresponding to each candidate state, and finally a sorting first state is reserved in each overturning item and a comparison group table is generated, so that unique comparison input can be provided for subsequent parallel association calculation.

S3, distributing the comparison group tables to parallel computing nodes in the industrial cloud computing environment, calling the same position table and the same abundance table for each comparison group, executing two times of association computation, and outputting the position comparison table;

In the embodiment, S3 is used for converting a comparison group table into a site comparison table on the premise that the same site table and the same abundance table are kept unchanged, wherein the processing sequence is that a unique distribution result is formed according to the comparison group scale and node resources, two correlation calculations in an included item state and an removed item state are respectively completed on each parallel calculation node, sequence drift and reconstruction deviation in the parallel calculation are eliminated through homologous comparison group result check, and finally site differences in the two states are uniformly written into the site comparison table, and the implementation process comprises the following steps:

S3-1, aiming at generating unique and executable node allocation results for each comparison group, and orderly expanding subsequent association calculation according to the resource bearing capacity and the public data multiplexing relation in an industrial cloud computing environment; the input quantity comprises a comparison group table, a site table, an abundance table and a parallel computing node resource table, wherein the comparison group table at least comprises a comparison group number, an inclusion item set, a removal item set and a turnover single item identification, and the parallel computing node resource table at least comprises a node number, an available memory quantity and an available computing thread number; the processing action is that firstly, the sample number in the joint sample list, the bit number in the position list and the number of the inclusion items in the corresponding inclusion item set are read for each comparison group, calculated amount is calculated according to the sample number multiplied by the bit number multiplied by the inclusion item number, memory occupation amount is calculated according to the sample number multiplied by the number of the inclusion item and the number of data bytes corresponding to the sample number multiplied by the bit number, common data multiplexing amount is calculated according to the number of the position list fields and the number of the abundance list fields shared between the comparison groups;

Performing two-part matching on the distribution cost matrix to obtain a feasible distribution set from a comparison group to parallel computing nodes, counting the total cost of the comparison groups carried by each node for each feasible distribution set, taking the maximum value in the total cost of each node as a maximum load value, reserving the distribution set with the minimum maximum load value, sorting the total sum of the common data multiplexing amounts from large to small when the maximum load values are the same, determining a unique distribution result from small to large when the total sum of the common data multiplexing amounts is the same, determining a node distribution table and a common cache table by output quantity, wherein the node distribution table at least comprises a comparison group number, a node number and a distribution sequence number, the common cache table at least comprises a node number, a shared position table fragment identifier and a shared abundance table fragment identifier, and writing the node number, the shared position table fragment identifier into a task scheduling storage area for S3-2 and S3-3 to read, and performing exception or deletion treatment to divide the comparison group into sub-comparison groups which are continuously segmented by positions when the memory occupation amount of a certain comparison group is larger than the maximum available memory amount of all parallel computing nodes, and then re-participating in distribution when the distribution cost exists in a space;

s3-2, aiming at respectively solving the association results of the same host site in the condition of the inclusion item state and the removal item state on each parallel computing node, so that the site difference can be directly computed according to the same comparison group in the follow-up process; the input quantity comprises a node allocation table, a site table, an abundance table, a comparison group table and a public cache table, wherein the processing action is that each parallel computing node reads the comparison group allocated to the node according to the node allocation table, and pre-loads shared site table fragments and shared abundance table fragments according to the public cache table;

Carrying out a gram matrix construction on each group of association design matrixes, carrying out orthogonal decomposition on the gram matrix to obtain an orthogonal basis for solving, carrying out regularized linear solving and log likelihood solving by taking a current target microorganism abundance vector as an observation vector, taking a parameter vector initial value, a residual vector initial value and a log likelihood initial value as inputs, taking a zero vector as the parameter vector initial value, taking the observation vector as the residual vector initial fitting vector, taking the log likelihood initial value as the observation vector initial fitting vector, solving according to a current parameter vector corresponding model, taking a regular parameter as a regular parameter field in a flow configuration table, and then carrying out Newton updating by multiplexing a previous train number vector, a residual vector and a likelihood value in each iteration to obtain a current train number vector, a current wheel residual vector and a current wheel likelihood value, extracting a host locus genotype column corresponding coefficient in the current train number vector as an effect value, taking the sign of the coefficient as a direction value, taking the current wheel residual vector square sum as a residual value and taking the current wheel likelihood value as a likelihood value;

Starting from the second round, if the symbol sequences of the continuous two-wheel system numbers are consistent and the lifting directions of the continuous two-wheel likelihood values are consistent, stopping iteration, if the maximum iteration round in the flow configuration table is reached and the stopping condition is not met, reserving the iteration result with the maximum likelihood value, wherein the output quantity is the effect value, the direction value, the residual value, the likelihood value and the condition number of the corresponding design matrix in two states, and writing the result into a node result storage area for S3-3 to read;

S3-3, aiming at performing consistency check on node results by utilizing the result repeatability among homologous comparison groups so as to remove abnormal results caused by sample sequence drift, matrix reconstruction difference or node calculation fluctuation, wherein input quantity comprises effect values, direction values, residual values, likelihood values and design matrix condition numbers in two states in a node result storage area, a public cache table and comparison group tables, processing actions are that each parallel computing node splices the effect values, the direction values, the residual values and the likelihood values in an inclusion item state and a removal item state according to a fixed field sequence for each host site of each comparison group, then adds host site identification and comparison group identification, generates site result fingerprints through Hash mapping, and then searches homologous comparison groups sharing the same site table segments and the abundance table segments with the current comparison group according to the public cache table, wherein the homologous comparison groups are defined as comparison groups with the same sample sequence, site table source and target microorganism source except for different turnover single items;

Performing consistency check on the current locus result fingerprint and the locus result fingerprint corresponding to the homologous comparison group, and directly reserving the current result if the fingerprints are consistent, if the fingerprints are inconsistent, performing sample sequence rearrangement, matrix reconstruction and re-association calculation on the current comparison group, wherein the sample sequence rearrangement is recovered according to the standard sample sequence in a joint sample table, the matrix reconstruction regenerates two groups of association design matrixes according to the original entry state and the removal state of the current comparison group, and then performs one-time recalculation according to the same solving rule of S3-2;

S3-4, the aim of uniformly converting two checked state results into a site comparison table which is directly called by subsequent showing item judgment, wherein the input quantity comprises a checking result table, the processing action comprises the steps of firstly reading an effect value, a direction value, a residual value and a likelihood value in an included item state, and removing the effect value, the direction value, the residual value and the likelihood value in the included item state from each comparison group in the checking result table, then subtracting the effect value of the removed item state from the effect value of the included item state to obtain an effect value difference, subtracting the residual value of the removed item state from the residual value of the included item state to obtain a residual difference, subtracting the likelihood value of the removed item state from the likelihood value of the included item state to obtain a likelihood difference, and then comparing the direction values in the two states, if the direction values are the same, marking the direction inversion marks as 0, and marking the direction inversion marks as 1 if the direction values are different;

Finally, writing the host site identification, the comparison group identification, the effect value difference, the direction flip mark, the residual error difference and the likelihood difference into a site comparison table according to the site sequence, wherein the output quantity is the site comparison table, and the site comparison table at least comprises the host site identification, the comparison group identification, the effect value difference, the direction flip mark, the residual error difference and the likelihood difference and is written into a comparison result storage area for S4 to read;

Through the processing, S3 converts the comparison group list into the site comparison list, so that the association difference of the same host site in the condition of the inclusion item state and the removal item state is solved under the input conditions of the unified sample sequence, the unified site sequence and the unified abundance, abnormal results in the parallel environment are removed through checking of the homologous comparison group, and the subsequent revealing item judgment can be directly carried out based on the site comparison list;

In practical application, the industrial cloud computing environment distributes comparison groups to different parallel computing nodes according to the number of samples, the number of bits and the number of inclusion items, then carries out association computation on the inclusion item state and the removal item state on each node respectively, carries out consistency check on the results of homologous comparison groups sharing the same position table segment and the abundance table segment, and finally writes the effect value difference, the direction flip mark, the residual error difference and the likelihood difference in the reserved results into the position comparison table, thereby providing unified input for subsequent display item judgment.

S4, collecting the same host position in the position point comparison table according to comparison items, calculating a difference value, recording a direction turning item, determining a display item according to the total accumulated difference value and the number of the direction turning items, and outputting a display position table;

In the embodiment, S4 is used for further converging two state differences in the site comparison table into display items corresponding to host sites and generating a display site table which is directly called by screening of subsequent condition display sites, wherein the processing sequence is that firstly, difference gathering is completed according to the host sites and the comparison items, then, homodromous difference groups and direction turnover items are distinguished according to direction consistency, then, the total quantity of accumulated difference values and the quantity of turnover items are respectively calculated for the homodromous difference groups and the direction turnover items, and finally, a unique display item of each host site is formed, and the implementation process comprises the following steps:

S4-1, the aim is to reassemble the two state results recorded in a scattered way in the site comparison table according to the host site and the comparison item and form a basic difference value field required by the judgment of the subsequent display item; the input quantity comprises a site comparison table, and the site comparison table at least comprises a host site identifier, a comparison item identifier, an inclusion state effect value, a removal state effect value, an inclusion state direction value, a removal state direction value, an inclusion state residual value, a removal state residual value, an inclusion state likelihood value and a removal state likelihood value; the processing action is that firstly grouping is executed according to the host site identification, and then secondary grouping is executed in each host site group according to the comparison item identification, so that two state results of the same host site under the same comparison item enter the same collecting unit; then, respectively reading an effect value of an inclusion state and an effect value of a removal state, a residual value of the inclusion state and a residual value of the removal state, an likelihood value of the inclusion state and a likelihood value of the removal state, and calculating an absolute value of the effect difference, an absolute value of the residual difference and an absolute value of the likelihood difference, wherein the absolute value of the effect difference is an absolute value of a difference between the effect value of the inclusion state and the effect value of the removal state, the absolute value of the residual difference is an absolute value of a difference between the residual value of the inclusion state and the residual value of the removal state, and the absolute value of the likelihood difference is an absolute value of a difference between the likelihood value of the inclusion state and the likelihood value of the removal state;

The method comprises the steps of storing a state-of-inclusion direction value and a state-of-removal direction value for next judgment, wherein the output quantity is a site collection table, and the site collection table at least comprises a host site identifier, a comparison item identifier, a state-of-inclusion direction value, a state-of-removal direction value, an effect difference absolute value, a residual difference absolute value and a likelihood difference absolute value, and writing the obtained result into a collection result storage area for S4-2 to read;

S4-2, aiming at splitting the difference of each comparison item into a cumulative homodromous difference value group and a countable direction turnover item according to the consistent relation of two state direction values, wherein the input quantity comprises a site collecting table, the processing action is that for each host site and each comparison item in the site collecting table, the included state direction value and the removed state direction value are compared, when the two are the same and the direction values are positive or negative, the effect difference value absolute value, the residual difference value absolute value and the likelihood difference value absolute value corresponding to the comparison item are written into the homodromous difference value group according to the fixed field sequence, the fixed field sequence is the first effect difference value absolute value, the later residual difference value absolute value and the likelihood difference value absolute value, and when the two are different, namely one is positive and the other is negative, the comparison item is recorded as the direction turnover item, the corresponding comparison item identifier and the field sequence number are recorded, and then all the homodromous difference value groups and all the direction turnover items are respectively summarized for each host site;

The output quantity is a locus difference value table which at least comprises a host locus mark, a comparison item mark, a homodromous difference value group, a direction turning mark and a field sequence number, and the locus difference value table is written into a difference value result storage area for S4-3 to read; the exception or deletion processing is that when the direction value has zero value, the direction value rule processing is carried out according to the direction value rule in the flow configuration table, the direction value rule is zero value and is incorporated into the non-overturn record, and the direction overturn mark of the comparison item is marked as 0;

S4-3, wherein the aim is to perform unified quantization on homodromous difference groups and direction turnover items of all host sites to form a unique display item judgment result, the input quantity comprises a site difference table, the processing action is to perform single rank ordering on all homodromous difference groups under each host site according to the effect difference absolute value from big to small, the residual difference absolute value from big to small and the likelihood difference absolute value from big to small, wherein each item is respectively and independently ordered, then perform summation on three rank orders of the same comparison item to generate a rank order value of the comparison item, then perform summation on the rank order values of all homodromous difference groups under the same host site to generate an accumulated difference total quantity of all comparison items corresponding to the host site, and directly count all direction turnover items under the same host site according to the number of the stripes to generate the number of turnover items;

The method comprises the steps of carrying out sorting according to the total quantity of accumulated differences from large to small and the field sequence of comparison items from small to large from front to back, wherein the sorting first comparison item is determined to be a display item of a host site, the output quantity is a display judging table, the display judging table at least comprises a host site identifier, a display item identifier, the total quantity of accumulated differences and the number of the comparison items, and writing the display judging table into a judging result storage area for S4-4 to read, and the abnormal or missing processing is that when the total quantity of accumulated differences of a plurality of comparison items and the number of the comparison items are completely the same, the smaller field sequence number of the comparison item is taken as the display item, and when a certain host site only has a direction inversion item and does not have a homodromous difference group, the comparison item with the minimum number of the inversion items and the minimum field sequence number is taken as the display item;

S4-4, the aim is to convert the display judging table into a display site table with fixed format and capable of directly entering a subsequent condition display site screening process, wherein the input quantity comprises the display judging table, the processing action is that firstly reading host site identifications, display item identifications, accumulated difference total amount and turnover item numbers in the display judging table one by one, and then executing result sorting according to ascending order of the host site identifications and ascending order of display item field sequence numbers;

The output quantity is a display locus table which at least comprises a host locus mark, a target microorganism mark, a display item mark, an accumulated difference total quantity and the number of turnover items, and is written into a display result storage area for S5 to read;

Through the processing, S4 converts the scattered state differences in the site comparison table into unique display items of each host site, and simultaneously reserves two judging result fields of the total quantity of the accumulated differences and the number of the turnover items, and the subsequent condition display site screening can finish aggregation and candidate gene annotation directly according to the display site table;

In practical application, the site comparison table corresponding to the same target microorganism is firstly assembled according to host sites and comparison items, then the comparison items with the same direction are written as homodromous difference value groups, the comparison items with opposite directions are marked as direction turnover items, then the total quantity of accumulated differences is calculated for the homodromous difference value groups, the number of the turnover items is obtained by counting the direction turnover items, finally, the unique display items are determined for each host site and written into the display site table, and the subsequent condition display site screening step can be directly carried out.

S5, screening out condition development sites according to the development site table, executing candidate gene annotation, writing in the condition development sites, corresponding target microorganisms, corresponding development items and corresponding candidate genes, and outputting excavation results;

In the embodiment, S5 is used for finishing condition display site screening and candidate gene determination on the basis of a display site table and forming a final excavation result table, wherein the processing sequence is that firstly, a position corresponding relation is established between the display site and a reference gene annotation table, then host sites are collected according to a target microorganism and gene adjacent relation and unique display items are determined, then candidate genes are determined according to a falling region relation or an adjacent relation, and finally, the condition display site, the target microorganism, the display items and the candidate genes are uniformly written into the excavation result table, and the implementation process comprises the following steps:

S5-1, aiming at establishing a unified and retrievable gene annotation relation for a development site, enabling the screening of the development site and the determination of candidate genes under the subsequent conditions to be carried out on the basis of the same coordinate system, wherein the input quantity comprises a development site table and a reference gene annotation table, the development site table at least comprises a host site identifier, a target microorganism identifier, a development item identifier, a cumulative total difference value and a turnover item number, the reference gene annotation table at least comprises a gene identifier, a chromosome number, a start coordinate, a termination coordinate and a chain direction, the processing action comprises the steps of firstly carrying out ascending sorting on each host site in the development site table according to the target microorganism identifier, the chromosome number and the genome coordinate, then reading the chromosome number and the genome coordinate of each host site, comparing with all gene intervals on the same chromosome in the reference gene annotation table, and recording the gene as a falling zone gene when the host site coordinate is positioned between the start coordinate and the termination coordinate of a certain gene and contains a boundary value;

When no falling region genes exist, respectively searching genes with coordinates smaller than the coordinates of the host site and closest to the coordinates of the host site in the same chromosome range as upstream adjacent genes, searching genes with coordinates larger than the coordinates of the host site and closest to the coordinates of the host site as downstream adjacent genes, and respectively solving an upstream boundary distance and a downstream boundary distance by the absolute value of the difference between the coordinates of the host site and the boundary coordinates of the corresponding genes; when the host locus falls into a plurality of gene intervals at the same time, determining a unique falling region gene from small to large according to the length of the gene interval and the initial coordinates of the gene from small to large, wherein the output quantity is a locus annotation relation table which at least comprises a host locus mark, a target microorganism mark, a display item mark, a falling region gene mark, an upstream adjacent gene mark, a downstream adjacent gene mark, an upstream boundary distance, a downstream boundary distance, an accumulated difference total quantity and a turnover item number, and writing the accumulated difference total quantity and the turnover item number into an annotation relation storage area for S5-2 to read;

S5-2, determining unique appearance items of each group of host sites from a site annotation relation table, reserving host sites belonging to the unique appearance items as conditional appearance sites, wherein the input quantity comprises a site annotation relation table, processing actions, namely firstly constructing an aggregation key according to target microorganisms and annotation relations, taking the target microorganisms identification and the falling zone gene identification as an aggregation key when falling zone gene identifications exist, taking the target microorganisms identification, upstream adjacent gene identifications and downstream adjacent gene identifications as the aggregation keys when falling zone gene identifications do not exist, then compiling host sites according to the aggregation keys, enabling host sites belonging to the same target microorganisms and pointing to the same gene interval or the same adjacent gene combination to enter the same aggregation result, and in each aggregation result, regrouping the host sites according to the appearance item identifications, respectively accumulating the total quantity of the accumulated difference values, accumulating the number of turnover items and counting the number of the host sites;

Then, according to the total quantity of accumulated differences from large to small, the number of turnover items from small to large and the sequence of fields of the appearance items from large to small, the first appearance item of the sequence is determined to be the unique appearance item of the collection result, finally, only the host site belonging to the unique appearance item is reserved as the condition appearance site, the output quantity is the condition appearance site table, the condition appearance site table at least comprises a collection key, a condition appearance site identifier, a target microorganism identifier, an appearance item identifier, the total quantity of accumulated differences, the number of turnover items, the number of host sites and corresponding annotation relation fields, and the condition appearance site storage area is written for S5-3 and S5-4 to read;

S5-3, determining a unique candidate gene for each collecting result in a condition display site table, so that a gene object in a final output result is unique and traceable, wherein the input quantity comprises the condition display site table, and the processing action is that collecting results in the condition display site table are firstly read one by one, when a falling zone gene mark exists in the current collecting result, the falling zone gene mark is directly used as the candidate gene, when the falling zone gene mark does not exist in the current collecting result, sorting selection is carried out between an upstream adjacent gene mark and a downstream adjacent gene mark, and sorting rules are that the boundary distance is from small to large in sequence, the total quantity of accumulated difference values of corresponding host sites is from large to small, and the total quantity of accumulated difference values of the condition display sites associated with corresponding adjacent genes is obtained from front to back in sequence;

The first adjacent gene is sequenced to be the candidate gene, the output is the candidate gene list, the candidate gene list at least comprises a collecting key, a candidate gene mark, a candidate gene source type, a corresponding boundary distance and a corresponding accumulated difference total amount, and the candidate gene list is written into a candidate gene storage area for S5-4 to read;

S5-4, combining the condition display sites and candidate genes according to the unified key value to finish results and generating a final mining result table, wherein the input quantity comprises a condition display site table and a candidate gene table, the processing action comprises the steps of firstly using a collecting key as an associated key, executing one-to-one association of the condition display site identifiers, target microorganism identifiers and display item identifiers in the condition display site table and the candidate gene identifiers in the candidate gene table, then executing ascending sort according to the target microorganism identifiers, the candidate gene identifiers and the condition display site identifiers, writing the condition display site, the corresponding target microorganism, the corresponding display item and the corresponding candidate gene into the mining result table, and synchronously writing the total accumulated difference value and the number of the turnover items as required as result interpretation fields;

The output quantity is an excavation result table which at least comprises a condition display site identifier, a target microorganism identifier, a display item identifier and a candidate gene identifier, and the excavation result table is written into a final result storage area for subsequent export and display calling; when the same condition display site corresponds to a plurality of candidate gene records, only records with higher priority of candidate gene source types and smaller boundary distance are reserved, wherein the priority of the candidate gene source types is determined according to the rule that the falling zone genes are higher than the adjacent genes;

Through the processing, S5 further converges the appearance site table into the unique corresponding relation between the condition appearance site and the candidate gene, ensures the final result and simultaneously retains three core information of the target microorganism, the appearance item and the candidate gene, and can be directly used for outputting and explaining the excavation result of the microorganism related gene subsequently;

In practical application, coordinate comparison is carried out on the display sites corresponding to the same target microorganism and a reference gene annotation table to obtain a region-falling gene or adjacent gene relation, host sites are collected according to the region-falling gene or adjacent gene combination, unique display items are determined in each collection result, the corresponding host sites are reserved as conditional display sites, unique candidate genes are determined according to rules of priority and adjacent distance of the region-falling relation, and finally the condition display sites, the target microorganism, the display items and the candidate genes are written into an excavation result table to form complete microorganism related gene excavation results.

The method comprises the steps of firstly aligning host whole genome sequencing data, metagenome sequencing data and sample attribute data of the same target group to the same sample sequence, respectively generating a site table, an abundance table, a fixed item table and a main component item table, then surrounding each target microorganism, carrying out item-by-item inclusion and removal on the fixed item and the main component item to form a comparison group which only changes one comparison item, respectively executing correlation calculation on each comparison group twice in an industrial cloud computing environment to obtain effect differences of the same host site in two states, gathering the differences according to the host sites, distinguishing which comparison items can cause obvious change of the correlation strength of the site and which comparison items can cause direction overturn, determining the appearance item for each host site, finally, corresponding the appearance site and gene annotation information, screening out condition appearance sites, determining candidate genes, and outputting the mining results of which target microorganism appears and which candidate gene corresponds under which comparison item;

For example, in the breeding study of raw pigs, researchers master the whole genome sequencing data of a batch of pigs, the sequencing data of intestinal metagenome and the attribute information of varieties, pig farms, sexes and the like at the same time, the three types of data are unified firstly, then, aiming at a certain target microorganism, the correlation results of all sites of the host are changed when the variety item is reserved and the variety item is removed, the pig farm item is reserved and the pig farm item is removed, and a certain main component item is reserved and a certain main component item is removed are compared respectively, if the correlation of a certain site is obviously weakened after the removal of a certain item or the direction is overturned, the development relationship of the site and the site is closely shown, and then, the development sites are put into a genome annotation section for positioning, so that host candidate genes which are related to the target microorganism and only show under specific conditions can be found more accurately, and the subsequent breeding screening, mechanism analysis and functional verification are facilitated.
